name: inheritance12.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (c Ref)(result Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (a Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (a Int)(b Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (a Int)(b Int)(c Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-C this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.c: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!c ((this Ref)) Ref
  (c (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.result: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!result ((this Ref)) Int
  (result (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.a: ---

(define-fun A!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.a: ---

(define-fun B!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-B this))
)

; --- getters for B.b: ---

(define-fun B!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-B this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class C:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for C.a: ---

(define-fun C.a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-C this))
)

(define-fun C!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.b: ---

(define-fun C.b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-C this))
)

(define-fun C!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-C this))
)

; --- getters for C.c: ---

(define-fun C.c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-C this))
)

(define-fun C!c ((this Ref)) Int
  (c (deref-C this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class A:
; ------------------------

(declare-fun A.f (Ref Int) Int)

(define-fun A!f ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (A.f this x)
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class B:
; ------------------------

(declare-fun B.f (Ref Int) Int)

(define-fun B!f ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (B.f this x)
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class C:
; ------------------------

(define-fun C.f ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ (+ (+ (C.a this) (C.b this)) (C.c this)) x)
)

(define-fun C!f ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ (+ (+ (C!a this) (C!b this)) (C!c this)) x)
)

(assert (!(forall ((this Ref)(x Int))
  (=>
    (and
      (deref-is-C this)
      (>= (C!a this) 0)
      (> x (C!a this))
      (>= (C!b this) 0)
      (>= (C!c this) 0)
    )
    (let (($result (C!f this x)))
      (and
        (>= $result 0)
        (> $result 0)
      )
    )
  )
) :named _xkassert0))

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!result this) (C.f (TopLevelDeclarations!c this) 10))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-C (TopLevelDeclarations!c this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!result this) 16)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert3))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert4))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 2) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun B.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!b this) 2)
)

(assert (! (B.inv2 2) :named _xkassert6))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-C C)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun C.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!a this) 1)
)

(assert (! (C.inv1 3) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!b this) 2)
)

(assert (! (C.inv2 3) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun C.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (C!c this) 3)
)

(assert (! (C.inv3 3) :named _xkassert9))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-B const-2-B))
        3 (lift-C const-3-C))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-C (select heap 3))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (c (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-C a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (= (result (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 16))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-B (select heap 2))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (c (sel-C (select heap 3))) 3))
(define-fun const-2-B () B
  (mk-B 1 2))
(define-fun const-3-C () C
  (mk-C 1 2 3))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (forall ((this Int) (x Int))
  (let ((a!1 (>= (a (sel-C (select heap this))) 0))
        (a!2 (> x (a (sel-C (select heap this)))))
        (a!3 (>= (b (sel-C (select heap this))) 0))
        (a!4 (>= (c (sel-C (select heap this))) 0))
        (a!5 (+ (a (sel-C (select heap this)))
                (b (sel-C (select heap this)))
                (c (sel-C (select heap this)))
                x)))
    (=> (and (is-lift-C (select heap this)) a!1 a!2 a!3 a!4)
        (and (>= a!5 0) (> a!5 0))))))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (b (sel-B (select heap 2))) 2))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 3 16))
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 1))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (= (b (sel-C (select heap 3))) 2))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (c (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (result (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
     (+ (a (sel-C a!1)) (b (sel-C a!1)) (c (sel-C a!1)) 10))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (a (sel-A (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 3 16)))
                  1
                  (lift-A (mk-A 1)))))
  (store (store a!1 2 (lift-B (mk-B 1 2))) 3 (lift-C (mk-C 1 2 3)))))
